prs.title: fix: don't add a redundant role to Separator's hr
prs.author: okeken
prs.body:
Closes #10894

## Summary

**Problem:** `<Separator />` renders `<hr role="separator">`. `<hr>` already has the `separator` role built in, so HTML validators flag the attribute as redundant (html-validate `no-redundant-role`).

**Intent:** a default `<Separator />` should be a plain `<hr>` that relies on its built-in role. Every separator that isn't rendered as an `<hr>` should still expose `role="separator"`, plus `aria-orientation` when vertical.

## Test Instructions

**Regression tests** in `packages/react-aria-components/test/Separator.test.js`:
- `should not add a redundant role to the default hr element` covers the example from the issue.
- `should add role to a horizontal div element`.
- `should expose role and orientation for a vertical separator`, run for three cases: default, `hr` and `div` elements.
